_comment: An on-chain test vector, not demo data. Nothing here is asserted: the referenceId and commitment address a reference really anchored on Base mainnet by ZegelAnchor 0xbcB85eCdeF23a11D5015b260cC4eDCc0c250f42e in tx 0xe35a44bd37ee922d719728dcc24e1e046dc98663bf406b9bb722202188d243b6. `zegel verify` reads the contract live and reports whatever it says. Its sibling anchored-reference-tampered.json is identical but for one hex digit of the commitment, which is how the chain is made to answer 4 (CommitmentMismatch) on demand.
